images.name: 余烬·狮子
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production concept illustration for a Skyrim SE fantasy bow mod, Leo zodiac, Chinese name below. One portrait 2:3 concept sheet, a full bow on the left (roughly 65 percent width), one consistent enlarged grip detail on the right. Both tips, complete silhouette and straight taut bowstring clearly visible. Clean readable simple geometric solid-light construction: substantial broad band faces, thick bevelled edges, open windows, layered structural pieces, fluorescent colored rims and darker colored faces. No metallic fittings, wood, leather, realistic lion head, animal sculpture, fur, textural cracks, busy crystalline noise, six-pointed stars, full magic-circle disks, arrows, people, background scene, watermark. Lion motif comes from abstract radiating mane, royal crown and claw silhouettes rather than figurative decoration. Maintain a narrow continuous ergonomic palm grip with arrow clearance. Every design must have an authored distinctive grip and shoulders, not two oval loops. High-end fantasy weapon concept art, controlled bloom, never blown-out white. Dark charcoal background, no distracting decorations. Sparse local draw-particle proposal near shoulder and limb, does not obscure bow. Large buildable forms, avoid tiny filigree. Exact bottom Chinese title: "余烬·狮子". Palette crimson, scarlet and rose-red. Design: radiant mane sovereign. A powerful recurve whose wide upper and lower shoulders flare into a fan of five broad angular triangular rays, radiating backward away from the string like an abstract lion mane. Each fan progressively transitions into three staggered long tapering trapezoid blades along the limbs. Central grip a faceted hourglass with open angular three-point crown collars on top and bottom, broad solid connecting base and triangular windows, clearly graspable. Crisp angular geometry dominates, heavy yet elegant, a strong regal silhouette. No crescent claws or previous Cancer-like curved pincer shoulders. Proposed particles: sparse tiny triangular red sparks between the mane rays, a few short outward streaks.
